Suggested entry (copy the exact list format):

## Inclusion criteria

Please confirm all that apply:

- [ ] **Zero runtime dependencies** (dev dependencies are allowed) **or** a single
      file / single binary with no install or build step.
- [ ] Actively maintained (a commit or release within roughly the last 12 months).
- [ ] Has a real README / documentation.
- [ ] Solves a real problem (not a toy or demo) and does not paywall basic use.
- [ ] Open-source license.
- [ ] Not already on the list, placed in the correct category, and alphabetized.
- [ ] The link is a plain canonical URL (no affiliate/tracking parameters).

## How did you verify it is zero-dependency?

<!-- e.g. "package.json has no `dependencies`", "distributed as a single static binary",
     "single .css/.js file with no imports", etc. -->
